reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for model selection, quick-answer routing, transient-failure fallback, and session-level token, cache, and cost monitoring.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于请求复杂度的模型路由、快速回答、故障降级以及会话用量和成本面板。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with complexity-based model routing, quick answers, transient-failure fallback, and session usage and cost monitoring.

capabilities: Classifies requests to select between cheap and strong language models
Runs quick answers on a cheap model when selected
Retries transient provider failures using a fallback model
Writes quick-answer exchanges and routing metadata into the session log
Displays session token, cache, model, and estimated cost metrics
Provides session-level auto/off routing controls through a command and tool
